x-provenance.recorded-by: Lenticule Science Senior and Red Cup Engineer Senior (pass kalshi-markets of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus)
x-provenance.basis: The raised-by and asks fields are the Leader's own words from the cited utterances; the requirements are the EARS rendering of what those words ask and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: The Kalshi desk is guarded by limits and blocks that bound what it risks, while the planned software is built, run and corrected by the Group's own mathematics and code.

requirements.says: The Kalshi desk shall keep every hard block on the Alpha holozing vile trading in force.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "That Alpha holozing vile we do want to keep hard-blocked from trading."

requirements.says: The Kalshi desk's guards shall each name the loss they prevent and shall bound size or venue without preventing the planned desk software from being written, run and its votes cast.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "we don't want the guards to be excuses for you to not develop the software we have planned out, not actually cast votes".

requirements.says: The Kalshi desk shall derive each probability, position and decision by computation in the Group's code over the Group's mathematics, with no language-model reading of data or reasoning in the decision path.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "YOU SHOULD BE BUILDING COMPUTERS THAT DO THAT REASONING VIA OUR MATEHMATICS" (compare kalshi-one-system-for-more-and-better-predictions R4).

requirements.says: Before a forecast receives capital, the Kalshi desk shall record a regime check that compares the forecast's direction with the observed regime of its series.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: weather code "bet against a heatwave in the middle of a heatwave".

requirements.says: Where a forecast tested at full confidence, the Kalshi desk shall re-test it against settled outcomes before capital rests on it.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: testing "showed like, 100% confidence on our San Diego bids, it now looks as though that was likely to be wrong".

requirements.says: When a defect is found in the Kalshi desk or one of its strategies, the Kalshi desk's owning software shall be corrected and the correction recorded, and the desk shall not be reported complete by being disarmed.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "You cannot call disarming your own enterprise 'done'" and "you need to fix them".

requirements.says: While the Kalshi desk is armed, each cycle shall record either an attempt to earn or the reason for none.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-10-06: "It seems like Kalshi has stopped trying to earn money?".

requirements.says: The Kalshi desk shall be recorded as armed, halted or oscillating only through receipts naming the act and its basis, so that the Leader's repudiation of rules never approved is visible.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "I didn't approve those rules"; "oscillating between recklessly spending on Kalshi and simply disabling it".

board-opening.context: Held beside the proven-false lane note (CN-6, CN-7) and kalshi-one-system R4; this record adds the guard stance, the regime check, the re-test and the no-disarm-as-done constraint.
